hero.description: Designing high-altitude attractions, developing custom nodes and trolleys. Increasing zipline throughput and reducing operational costs.

about.name: Vasyl Baranovsky
about.bio: High-altitude attraction engineer and equipment designer. 10+ years designing, building, and optimizing facilities where errors are unacceptable. Developing custom nodes and trolleys that increase throughput and reduce equipment wear.
about.title: ENGINEERING SOLUTIONS FOR REDUCING OWNERSHIP COSTS AND INCREASING THROUGHPUT
about.subtitle: Design considering the full lifecycle of the attraction: from optimizing the start cycle to reducing component wear.

traffic.title: MAXIMIZING TRAFFIC
traffic.desc: Optimizing geometry of launch platforms and applying custom trolleys. Increasing throughput without compromising safety.

opex.title: REDUCING OPERATIONAL COSTS
opex.desc: Precise calculation of cable sag and friction combined with wear-resistant nodes. Preventing downtime and equipment wear.

safety.title: SAFETY AND BRAKING SYSTEMS
safety.desc: Calculating dynamic and peak loads. Direct integration of magnetic braking systems. Reducing legal and operational risks.

rnd.title: CUSTOM NODE DEVELOPMENT
rnd.desc: Developing non-standard nodes and mechanisms when off-the-shelf equipment doesn't provide the required durability or speed.

products.title: ENGINEERING SYSTEMS AND SPECIAL EQUIPMENT
products.subtitle: Three production items from the catalog: from a chair system to an autonomous robot. Each is engineered around real commercial zipline challenges — throughput, safety, and cost of ownership.

chair.title: CHAIR SYSTEM FOR COMMERCIAL ZIPLINE
chair.description: A suspended delivery system for getting guests to the launch platform: expands the audience to children, seniors and people with disabilities, shortens the boarding cycle and reduces staff workload.

details.purpose: Increasing throughput, expanding audience (children, elderly, people with disabilities).
details.seat: Wear-resistant composite, cordura with UV and precipitation protection, water accumulation protection.
details.suspension: Rigid/semi-rigid connection to trolley to minimize lateral sway.
details.loads: Working load up to 135 kg, breaking load > 22 kN.
details.safety: 4-point harnesses with self-opening protection, redundant backup line, built-in damping.
details.efficiency: Saves 60-80% time at start, reduces staff workload.

magnet.title: MAGNETIC ROLLER FOR HIGH-SPEED ZIPLINE (UP TO 80 KM/H)
magnet.description: A trolley with contactless magnetic braking for high-speed lines. Braking force is individually calculated for the geometry of each track.

details.speed: Up to 80 km/h with optimal track geometry.
details.magnetic: Individual calculation of magnetic braking force for track geometry.
details.materials: Aviation aluminum, hardened steel, reinforced sealed bearings.
details.durability: Contactless magnetic elements minimize wear and maintenance.
details.usage: Rigid connection with chair suspensions without play.

shmel.title: SUSPENDED AUTONOMOUS TRANSPORT ROBOT "SHMEL"
shmel.description: An autonomous suspended platform for cargo transport and cable inspection. Operates without an operator, radio-controlled, with a full safety circuit.

details.mechanics: Drive wheels 140 mm with polyurethane bandage, 2 servo motors 48V 600W each, speed up to 3.5 m/s.
details.control: Radio system "Pitch and Catch" (2 operators), DCSC controller with S-curves.
details.autonomy: Autonomous movement along the cable, possibility of operation without operator.
details.safety: Mechanical limit switches, E-STOP system (<0.5s), battery discharge monitoring (<43V).
details.applications: Cargo transportation, cable inspection, technical maintenance.
